peer_review_model.notes: Matters Arising and Replies undergo peer review.

article_types.description: Formal post-publication commentary on original research papers published within the past 18 months in Nature. Can involve challenges or clarifications.

total_word_limit.notes: Main text should be as concise as possible, ideally not exceeding 1,200 words.

required_sections: Brief paragraph summarizing the message for non-specialist readers (used as the abstract)

figure_limits.notes: Ideally requires only one or two small figures or tables. Complex figures or tables may be presented as Extended Data items (up to 3).

reference_limit.notes: Reference style is as for Articles.

required_statements: Correspondence with the original authors must be included as an attachment.
article_types.notes: Published online but not in print. Must be measured in tone, no inflammatory language. Must contact original authors before submission. Confidentiality required for original authors.

remarks: No article processing charges (out of scope for this schema, noted here since it was explicitly stated in the text).
